purpose: Observe the operational new-version world under the unchanged broad invitation, separately from prompted diagnostics
pause_between_blocks: Fresh runner process; restore world and reconstruct exact conversation before continuing
initial_context: candidate default short mechanical description and original curiosity invitation; empty system
no_new_material: No puzzles, rewards, demonstrations, task requests, investigator assessments, summaries or hints added during the pilot
ordinary_behavior: Writing, repetition, incomplete cells, errors, successful actions and partial state changes are all retained. None is a semantic continuation gate.
stop_conditions: Unknown/uncommitted effect, dependency/reference drift, exact context capacity boundary or user pause; no silent repair or replay
observations: complete declared code cells and actual receipts
scope: Usable operational foundation and open observation, not proof of emergence, general competence, autonomous repair, weight learning or a required developmental trajectory
activation: After integrity and operational-evidence review, record an explicit new-version activation while preserving original1550 and the old pointer. Do not relabel redesigned conditions as unchanged continuation.
